citation: HL7 v2.3 Chapter 8, section 8.3.3 MFQ/MFR - master files query, p 8-5. Structure ID MFQ_M01 synthesised as CODE_EVT from the message code MFQ and M01, the first event overrides.json eventsFromTitle gives it (v2.3 prints no structure ID and no Table 0354). Events MFQ^M01, MFQ^M02, MFQ^M03, MFQ^M04, MFQ^M05, MFQ^M06, MFQ^M07, MFQ^M08, MFQ^M09, MFQ^M10 and MFQ^M11 from overrides.json eventsFromTitle (section 8.3.3 'MFQ/MFR - master files query' names no event): HL7 v2.3 Chapter 8, section 8.3.3 MFQ/MFR - master files query, p 8-5 (v2.3 prints the message code alone and no structure ID; the section title names no event); Table 0003 (Chapter 2, section 2.24.1.9, pp 2-90 to 2-93), p 2-92: 'varies MFQ/MFR - Master files query (use event same as asking for e.g., M05 - location)', the master file events being M01 to M11 of the same table..
